WITH vendor_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    v.vendregistry,
    m.sizecluster,
    -- VTI calculation
    ROUND(CAST(
      (CAST(v.vendsucccount AS numeric) / v.vendtxcount) * 100 
      - (CAST(v.venddisputecount AS numeric) / v.vendtxcount) * 50 
      + (v.vendrate * 5)
    AS numeric), 2) AS vti,
    -- VNC calculation
    ROUND(CAST(
      (COUNT(DISTINCT v.mktref) * 5) 
      + (CAST(v.vendtxcount AS numeric) / 50) 
      + (((CAST(v.vendsucccount AS numeric) / v.vendtxcount) * 100 
          - (CAST(v.venddisputecount AS numeric) / v.vendtxcount) * 50 
          + (v.vendrate * 5)) * 0.1)
      - (1 - CASE m.sizecluster 
            WHEN 'Small' THEN 1 
            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 
            WHEN 'Large' THEN 3 
            WHEN 'Mega' THEN 4 
            ELSE 1 END) * 10
    AS numeric), 2) AS vnc
  FROM vendors v
  LEFT JOIN markets m ON v.mktref = m.mktregistry
  GROUP BY v.vendregistry, v.vendspan, v.vendrate, v.vendtxcount, v.vendsucccount, v.venddisputecount, v.vendplacecount, v.vendpaymethods, v.vendchecklvl, v.vendlastmoment, v.mktref, m.sizecluster
)
SELECT vendregistry, sizecluster, vti, vnc
FROM vendor_metrics
ORDER BY vnc DESC;
